title: [SUBS] Backrooms (2026) - Movie Streaming @ Stan
body:
Deal: [SUBS] Backrooms (2026) - Movie Streaming @ Stan

[TheDukeOfNukem] Ayyo, cool. We missed this at the movies and I didn't care enough to pirate. Cheers!
[Charlie Dont Surf] Charlie's Movie Recommendation - check out Red Rooms (2023) instead.
[Laziofogna] I checked my IMDB, I gave a 5 when I watched it
[MrZ] What do you expect from a movie based entirely off one creepypasta photo.
[QuickToThePointless] What do you expect from a movie based entirely off one creepypasta photo.
in decades gone by i'd expect no movie made, let alone pitched and considered.
however, the budget horror genre especially is off the rails where any kid with 1/8 of an idea and 1/16 of a respectable budget gets a green light as generation idiocracy seem to lap this shit up and ultimately a guaranteed profit is turned.
streaming content is all about quantity; not quality.
and film is no longer art; its another excercise in bean counting.
[nosytt] Guess you're not old enough to remember having to stroll through the VHS tapes at blockbuster, especially the horror or even the kung fu section, yes we had a dedicated section for kung fu films
[QuickToThePointless] @nosytt: we're in the horror streaming section - what the kung fu… k'you talking about?
[Franc-T] I thought it was fine. Wasnt brilliant at all but not a waste of time.
[Click_It] I didn't mind it, didn't love it and won't watch it again anytime soon but it was okay. The storyline was disjointed and there were possibilities for more, but more didn't come. Still worth a watch though imo.
